forWhat: What each campus store holds, what it must buy for the month, and the count you do at the end of a term.
Only the person who keeps a campus store sees Stock: the operations lead of the campus, a coordinator or a founder. Everyone else has no Stock line.

layout.shows: [[On hand]] lists what the store holds. [[Buy list]] says what to buy for a month. [[Count]] is the count you do on your phone.
Each item says how much is held, its minimum and one word: enough, low, none, or count it. What needs you comes first. Choose an item to see its history.
The item you chose, with what you can do to it: [[Stock in]], [[Hand out]], [[Set the minimum]] and [[Write off]]. Its history is written in words.

jobs.title: Record stock that arrived
steps: Open Stock and choose the item.
Press [[Stock in]], and type how many came.
If you bought it on a claim, choose the claim. It is optional.
Press [[Record stock in]]. The store shows the new number at once.

jobs.title: Hand stock to a class
steps: Choose the item and press [[Hand out]].
Type which class took it, and how many.
Press [[Hand it out]]. If the store goes below zero the item says count it, so you know to count it.

jobs.title: Count the store
steps: Open [[Count]]. Each item shows what the books say.
Type what you see on the shelf. Leave out any item you did not count.
Press [[Save the count]]. If a number is far from the books, a box opens for you to say why. Nothing is saved until every line is accepted.
The store then holds what you counted, and the difference is kept.

jobs.title: Read the buy list and send it
steps: Open [[Buy list]] and choose the month.
Each line shows what the classes need, what the store holds and what to buy. A line that says to confirm has a class that gave no quantity, so ask that class.
Press [[Send checklist]] to open the same WhatsApp checklist the inventory person gets.

jobs.title: Set a minimum, or write stock off
steps: Choose the item. Press [[Set the minimum]] and type the least the store should hold. An item below it says low.
To write off stock that was lost or spoilt, press [[Write off]], type how many, and say why. A write-off needs a reason.

buttons.label: Record stock in
buttons.does: Adds what arrived to the store.
buttons.doesNot: It does not pay for anything. The claim does that.

buttons.label: Hand it out
buttons.does: Takes what a class was given out of the store.
buttons.doesNot: It does not stop at zero. The item then says count it.

buttons.label: Save the minimum
buttons.does: Keeps the least the store should hold of this item.

buttons.label: Write it off
buttons.does: Takes lost or spoilt stock out of the store, with your reason.
buttons.doesNot: It does not delete the history. The write-off stays written.

buttons.label: Save the count
buttons.does: Sets the store to what you counted and keeps each difference.
buttons.doesNot: It does not save anything if one line still needs a reason.

buttons.label: Send checklist
buttons.does: Opens WhatsApp with the lines still to buy as a checklist.
buttons.doesNot: It does not send anything until you press send in WhatsApp.
